step1_analysis.description: The circuit contains two inverters forming the storage nodes of an SRAM cell (with the feedback loop broken in this extraction) and a matchline pull-down network used for tag comparison in a CAM. The matchline is pulled down if there is a mismatch between the stored data and the search lines.

paper_reference.title: A 1-V 128-kb Four-Way Set-Associative CMOS Cache Memory Using Wordline-Oriented Tag-Compare (WLOTC) Structure with the Content-Addressable-Memory

t_match_pulldown.description: Delay from search line activation to matchline pull-down (evaluating a mismatch).

sky130_expected.calculation: R_pulldown ~ 1kΩ (two series NMOS W=5u L=0.5u). C_load ~ 50fF. Delay ~ R*C = 50ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper reports 3.5ns for the full 128-kb macro hit access time, which includes routing, wordline decoding, and sense amplifiers. The isolated cell delay is purely the RC delay of the local pull-down transistors, which is much faster.

power_avg.description: Average power consumption of the cell during search operations.

sky130_expected.calculation: Static power from 10kΩ pull-up resistor during matchline low state (20ns out of 50ns period) dominates. I = 1.8V/10kΩ = 180uA. Avg I = 180uA * 0.4 = 72uA. Power = 72uA * 1.8V = 130uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper reports 4.1mW for the entire 128-kb cache. A single cell's power in this testbench is dominated by the artificial pull-up resistor used to simulate the precharge/evaluate behavior of the matchline.

t_inv_delay.description: Propagation delay of the internal SRAM inverters.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard CMOS inverter delay for W=5u L=0.5u in 130nm process with minimal loading.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure the internal inverter delays, matchline pull-down delays for both comparison paths, and average power consumption over a 50MHz cycle.
step3_testbench.spice:
* 10T CAM Cell Testbench
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* DUT
XM1 N3 N7 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N0 N3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N6 LABEL_NET_0 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N1 LABEL_NET_2 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N0 N3 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N1 N3 N6 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N1 N5 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N3 N7 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N3 N2 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N5 N2 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}

* Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VN4 N4 0 0
VN2 N2 0 1.8
R_ML VDD N1 10k

* Stimuli (50MHz -> 20ns period)
* N7 toggles to test inverter chain and enable/disable Path 1
V_N7 N7 0 PWL(0 1.8 10n 1.8 10.1n 0 30n 0 30.1n 1.8 50n 1.8)
* SL0 tests Path 1 (requires N3=1.8V, i.e., N7=0V)
V_SL0 LABEL_NET_0 0 PWL(0 0 15n 0 15.1n 1.8 25n 1.8 25.1n 0 50n 0)
* SL2 tests Path 2 (independent of N3 in this extraction)
V_SL2 LABEL_NET_2 0 PWL(0 0 35n 0 35.1n 1.8 45n 1.8 45.1n 0 50n 0)

* Load capacitance
C_N3 N3 0 10f
C_N0 N0 0 10f
C_N1 N1 0 50f

.control
tran 10p 50n

* Inverter delays
meas tran t_inv1_rise trig v(N7) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(N3) val=0.9 rise=1
meas tran t_inv1_fall trig v(N7) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(N3) val=0.9 fall=1
meas tran t_inv2_rise trig v(N3) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(N0) val=0.9 rise=1
meas tran t_inv2_fall trig v(N3) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(N0) val=0.9 fall=1

* Matchline pull-down delays
meas tran t_pulldown1 trig v(LABEL_NET_0) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(N1) val=0.9 fall=1
meas tran t_pulldown2 trig v(LABEL_NET_2) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(N1) val=0.9 fall=1

* Power measurement
let power = -i(VVDD)*1.8
meas tran pwr_avg avg power

print t_inv1_rise t_inv1_fall t_inv2_rise t_inv2_fall t_pulldown1 t_pulldown2 pwr_avg
quit
.endc
